title: Measuring and predicting the ζ-potential of anthropogenic TiO2 nanoparticles in surface waters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4646-4664
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00248F, Paper
Allan Philippe, Narjes Tayyebi Sabet Khomami, Michel Gad, Fintan Hahn, Vanessa Trouillet, Oliver Lechtenfeld, Stefan Kunz, María José Gormaz Aravena, Vanessa Wollersen, Eliana Di Lodovico
We propose a novel approach for determining and predicting the ζ-potential of nanoparticles in surface waters based on the water composition and environmental parameters.
